content:
incident-bot: PAGED SRE oncall - API gateway (apigw-main) reporting elevated 502/504 rates in eu-west-1 and us-east-1 :rotating_light:

incident-bot: Severity: SEV2 - observed 502/504 spike starting ~3113141500, currently ongoing. Pager: @oncall_ryan

sre_jordan: Acked. looking at ingress metrics now, thanks for the page.

oncall_ryan: I'm on it. which routes are impacted? any customer tickets?

api_prod_bot: Alert summary: 5xx-rate increased from 0.3% -> 16% over 2m. Top upstream: mux-proxy pools -> 502 spike. Avg p50 latency up 40ms.

support_anya: Customer channel picking up a handful of user reports for timeouts, flagging one premium customer with high error rate. forwarding sample request IDs in thread.

eng_infra_leah: Checking mux-proxy pool sizes and keepalive metrics. I see connection churn to upstreams and many `502` responses logged with `upstream_reset` on the proxy side.

ops_chris: Any config rollouts in last 30m? I can roll back if needed.

pm_maria: No product config pushes. We did a scaling test earlier but it targeted dedicated capacity, not apigw.

oncall_ryan: Quick mitigation plan: (1) enable short-circuit fallback for non-critical routes -> return cached 200s where safe (2) circuit-break upstreams that show >20% errors (3) shift small percent of traffic to us-west region.

eng_infra_leah: Started circuit-break on `mux-proxy-pool-3` (suspected leak) at 3113141620. Watch metrics.

sre_jordan: Rolling out temporary backend fallback for /v1/generate on non-dedicated routes (cache TTL 5s) to reduce fanout to failing pool.

api_prod_bot: Telemetry: after circuit-break, error rate dropped to 9% in eu-west-1 within 45s, but us-east still spiking.

support_anya: Noted customer impact down from 20% -> 7% for the flagged customer. They're asking for ETA.

oncall_ryan: ETA ~20m for stabilization if trends continue. informing CS.

eng_infra_leah: Found noisy keepalive timeouts between mux-proxy and downstream inference cluster - socket timeout increased to 2s from 500ms after recent kernel update on a subset of hosts. reverting kernel param on the subset now.

ops_chris: Rolling revert to previous kernel param on host group `inference-pool-eu-1` at 3113141740.

api_prod_bot: Post-revert metrics: eu-west p50 latency normalizing; 502 rate down to 3% at 3113141795. us-east still at ~8%.

sre_jordan: For us-east I'm triggering a graceful traffic drain on node group `mux-proxy-pool-7` and will replace instances.

eng_infra_leah: Drains started, replacement autoscale triggered. Also pushing a temporary client-side retry tweak: lower retries to 1 with exponential backoff to avoid thundering herd.

support_anya: CS informed customers: "We are seeing transient gateway errors; mitigation in progress; estimated recovery within 20-30 minutes." customer replied :thumbsup:.

pm_maria: Please capture root cause notes for postmortem: kernel keepalive change + unhealthy mux-proxy pool amplification. Need timeline and who reverted what.

oncall_ryan: Agreed. I'll own the incident until we hand off to postmortem.

ops_chris: Replacement nodes healthy, us-east 502 rate down to 2% at 3113141850.

incident-bot: INCIDENT UPDATE: severity downgraded to info at 3113141855. no ongoing customer-impacting errors above threshold.

sre_jordan: Thanks team — starting incident writeup now. I'll include timestamps, mitigations (circuit-break, kernel revert, drain/replace), and follow-ups (add healthcheck guard, config test before kernel upgrades).

eng_infra_leah: +1 on healthcheck guard and an automated preflight for kernel/network changes.

pm_maria: Schedule postmortem with infra + runtime SME tomorrow.

support_anya: Notifying affected customers with incident summary.

oncall_ryan: Handing off to SRE for postmortem. Good job everyone. :tada:
